response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.transreg AS transreg, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT t.*, AVG(avg_short) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS dummy FROM t), grp AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist) SELECT t.transreg AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, t.avg_short AS avg_short_interest, t.avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio, t.avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(grp.grp_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM t LEFT JOIN grp ON t.ordertypedist IS grp.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
